definition: ExistenceFact.fact x is a tagged candidate proposition that individual x exists at the selected world. A token for x is not evidence of actual existence there; existence is still m.ontic.ExistsAt w x. This model intentionally covers existence facts only, not the unrestricted PSR over every truth or state of affairs.
note: A typed analyst model for the existence-PSR scope question in #312. The tag prevents sliding from an individual's causal predecessor to the explanation of an existential fact; it introduces no independently defended ontology of facts.
